packageRules.description: Node of the CSS build: .node-version and pom.xml move together.
The Playwright package drives the browsers of the pinned image, so both move together. The screenshot tests guard the update.
KoSIT publishes technical previews as 2.0.0-tpN. Maven versioning reads them as releases, and their jar is missing on Central.
The test database stays on the production major. A major upgrade runs first on lemming (dump and restore, intranet repository), then this limit moves in the same step.
